identifiedBy.fact: From Horseshoe Meadow climb to Mulkey Pass; climber.org driving page names the unmarked Mulkey Pass trailhead as the efficient start for Mulkey Pass

placements.source: climber.org driving GPX (waypoint MULKEY, 'Mulkey Pass Trailhead 9900')
placements.name: Mulkey Pass Trailhead

otherFacts.value: Golden Trout Wilderness; overnight permit from Lone Pine; day use none

notes: Mulkey Pass TH is an unmarked dirt road with a closed-to-vehicles sign; parking is a horse-trailer lot on the north side of the paved road. Placement is one non-land-manager source; Cottonwood Pass TH (USFS 36.4483,-118.1706, ~0.9 km west) is the alternative longer start, not this one. Mulkey GPX point is the closest placement; OSM name match by script.

trailhead.name: Mineral King trailhead (Eagle-Mosquito / Sawtooth Pass / Monarch Lakes TH)

identifiedBy.fact: Mineral King trailhead (7830) to Crystal Lake, over Amphitheatre Col, climbed Needham; a second report starts at Monarch Lakes TH in Mineral King for Sawtooth + Needham

notes: Two independent pages name the Mineral King road end; no other trailhead plausible. Two start spellings (Crystal Lake side vs Monarch Lakes) both leave the same road-end area. Prefer NPS Sawtooth (Sawtooth/Monarch trails) or Eagle-Mosquito; they are ~0.5-1 km apart, so name-level match only.

Weak only: sources (MP area page, Gaia, search summaries) say most NEWS routes are approached from the west via Blue Lake Trail #314 (USFS Blue Lake Trailhead 48.519016,-120.674215), but none lists this route or its side. MP NEWS area lists only six routes (Chockstone, Early Winter Couloir, Flycatcher Buttress, Labor Pains, Northwest Corner, West Face); this route is absent. SummitPost returned 403. If a default is acceptable, Blue Lake TH is the inferred start; not confirmed.
Same as Christianson-Roskelley: no page names this route. Inferred lead only, Blue Lake TH (west-side approach shared by most NEWS routes). SummitPost 403, MP area page does not list it.
A targeted search for 'Vulcan Death Grip' returned nothing relevant. Inferred lead only, Blue Lake TH. Not confirmed.

trailhead.name: Shake Camp Trailhead (Long Meadow Trail 31E15, Mountain Home State Forest)

identifiedBy.fact: USFS: Long Meadow Trail begins at Shake Camp; trip reports start North Maggie at Shake Camp, drop to and cross the Tule River, climb west slopes via the drainage between the summit and Pt 10,113

placements.source: climber.org driving GPX (SHAKEC, Shake Camp Trailhead 6500; from earlier pass)
placements.name: Shake Camp Trailhead

notes: USFS page itself does not mention North Maggie; link is via route text (Long Meadow, Tule River, Pt 10,113) matching the trip reports. Reasonably strong. Placements not land-manager; USFS page prints no coordinate.

Identity of North Peak unresolved. Searches suggest North Peak = North Gunsight Peak (8,160 ft), whose West Face is reached by Downey Creek trail + Bachelor Creek (stephabegg.com, upwardescape blog), but the Mountain Project 'North Peak' area (1 route, West Face, GPS 48.5093,-120.66) carries coordinates near Early Winters, not the Gunsight Range, so MP data is muddled. No page about a North Ridge. Other Gunsight approaches (Agnes Creek via Stehekin) exist. Downey Creek TH is only an inferred lead for the west side.
Same as North Ridge: no page about the Southeast Buttress; a southeast side may be approached from the east (Agnes Creek/Stehekin or Entiat) rather than Downey Creek; unresolved.

otherFacts.value: ~1.5 mi one way, Class 3-4 on Cloudy east ridge or drop south around cliff band

notes: Three plausible starts, none tied to this route: Holden Village/Railroad Creek (Lucerne ferry + bus; Lyman Lake ~16 mi from Holden), Phelps Creek TH over Spider Gap, and Trinity TH (end of Chiwawa River road) via Buck Pass and Suiattle Pass to Cloudy Pass (countryhighpoints.com, opened; Class 2 North Star trip that touches Cloudy Peak). WTA 403. Route text lists two starts itself. Trinity TH (USFS 48.071972,-120.850005) is the only one with a road trailhead and a page describing a Cloudy Pass->Cloudy Peak->North Star line, but that is the page author's loop, not this route; weak.
